critical.description: sae_graph = build_graph() executes at module import time, instantiating TutorAgent, AuditorAgent, SearcherAgent, KnowledgeGraph. If Ollama is not running at startup, SovereigntyError or a connection error is raised, crashing the entire import.
critical.fix: Wrap sae_graph in a lazy getter function or wrap build_graph() in a try/except with a descriptive error message.

critical.description: numpy is used (np.dot for cosine similarity) but NOT listed in requirements.txt. On a fresh pip install, all semantic grading calls fail with ModuleNotFoundError.

major.description: get_tutor_agent() cache_resource singleton is defined but never called. page_loading_lesson() instantiates TutorAgent() directly on every visit, discarding the instance cache each time.
major.fix: Replace TutorAgent() in page_loading_lesson() with get_tutor_agent(), and call tutor.teach_concept(concept, domain) to use the singleton cache.

major.description: The run() LangGraph method only stores state['lesson_content'] = lesson.get('introduction', ''). The other 5 sections are generated but discarded in the CLI/LangGraph path.
major.fix: Concatenate all 6 sections into lesson_content or store each section under its key in state.

major.description: Hard-coded dark CSS colours (#1e293b, #0f172a) throughout the file. With app.py's new light theme, the test page renders as a dark island inside the light application.
major.fix: Update all CSS hex colour values to match app.py's light theme palette.

major.description: roadmap_display.py is not imported by app.py. The Plotly Sankey flow diagram and _render_module_card() are dead code. app.py reimplements the roadmap display inline.
major.fix: Either import and use roadmap_display.py in page_roadmap() (and update to light theme), or delete the file.

major.description: integrity/xp_engine.py and integrity/stress_relief.py do not exist. No XP tracking, leveling, or standalone stress detection is implemented.
major.fix: Implement xp_engine.py with per-event point awards and JSON persistence. Implement stress_relief.py as an adapter over affective_pacing.py.

minor.description: LOG_PATH = './mastery_log.jsonl' is relative to CWD — log may be created in wrong directory.
CERTS_DIR = './certificates' is relative to CWD — certificates may be saved to wrong directory.
list(self._frame_queue.queue) accesses queue internals without the Queue's lock — minor thread safety issue.
minor.fix: Use copy.copy() under self._lock to snapshot the queue contents safely.

minor.description: _BEEP_B64 contains a minimal WAV header with zero audio data — warning beep is silent.
minor.fix: Replace with a valid base64-encoded 440 Hz tone WAV file.

minor.description: KnowledgeGraph seeds only a hardcoded 10-node ML curriculum. Dynamic roadmap domains are not reflected in the graph.
minor.fix: Add roadmap concept nodes dynamically from roadmap modules during roadmap generation.

minor.description: Generated HTML animation includes Google Fonts @import URL — violates offline-first sovereignty principle.
minor.fix: Remove Google Fonts import and use system-ui font stack only.

minor.description: Global CSS @import for Google Fonts (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans) requires internet connection.
minor.fix: Bundle fonts locally or accept system-ui fallback in offline use.

recent_changes.change_summary: Full rewrite: replaced single large Ollama prompt with 6 dedicated SECTION_PROMPTS, added _call_ollama() with 3-retry logic and >30 char validation, replaced class-level cache with instance-level self._cache, added rich paragraph-length _fallback() for all 6 sections.
introduced_bugs: run() only stores introduction in state
get_tutor_agent() singleton never called — cache wasted on each lesson load

recent_changes.change_summary: Full rewrite: replaced single 10-module Ollama prompt with _get_titles() (1 call) + _generate_module() (1 call per module). Added json_repair, progress_callback, Wikipedia resource fetch per module, and ./data/roadmaps/ JSON cache.

Full rewrite: replaced Manim subprocess (60s, requires LaTeX) with synchronous HTML5 Canvas animation generation. LLM extracts structured JSON (title, definition, key_points, formula, fun_fact), _build_html() creates a 6-slide Canvas 2D animated HTML file. Added generate_in_background() shim.

Major expansion: complete light theme redesign (white cards, purple gradient, Inter fonts), new page_loading_lesson() with 6 live progress cards, new page_lesson() with two-column layout and section pills, LESSON_SECTIONS constant, router updated with loading_lesson and loading_test, Start button navigates to loading_lesson.
